verdict.rationale: Plaid IDV supports webhook-driven automation (STEP_UPDATED/STATUS_UPDATED/RETRIED events) and a workflow editor with conditional logic that can run checks automatically without manual intervention, and an official MCP server is documented, which would let AI agents trigger these flows autonomously. However there is no evidence of AI-agent-specific tooling, scheduling, or documentation describing autonomous background operation beyond webhook/event subscriptions and workflow conditionals. Missing for 10: explicit AI-agent orchestration examples, autonomous scheduling/triggers beyond webhooks, and independent confirmation that the MCP server enables full background automation.
